name: dashback
description: Automatically learns and completes Geometry Dash levels using a variety of algorithms.

enabled.name: Enable Solver
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, dashback does nothing and the game plays normally.

algorithm.name: Algorithm
algorithm.description: Which solver to run. One of: backtracking, random, genetic.

max-attempts.name: Max Attempts
max-attempts.description: Give up after this many attempts (0 = unlimited).

solve-speed.name: Solve Speed
solve-speed.description: Game speed multiplier while solving. Physics is fixed-step, so this only makes iteration faster without affecting determinism. Adjust live in-game with [ and ]. Reset to 1 when you leave the level.

search-granularity.name: Search Granularity
search-granularity.description: How many frames the backtracking probe steps at a time. 1 = every frame (fully deterministic / complete). Higher scans faster but can miss frame-perfect jumps.

auto-solve-daily.name: Auto-solve Daily (experimental)
auto-solve-daily.description: Attempt to automatically open and solve the Daily level. Not yet fully implemented.
